title: Real-analytic standard families and rotational invariant curves
summary: In this paper we study one-parameter families of exact standard maps of the form $$\widehat{f}_{k,g}(\widehat{x},\widehat{y}) =\bigl(\widehat{x}+\widehat{y}+kg(\widehat{x}) \bmod 1,\widehat{y}+kg(\widehat{x})\bigr),$$ where $k$ is a real parameter and $g:\mathbb{T} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ is real-analytic, 1-periodic and has zero mean. The most famous example is when $g(\widehat{x})=\frac{\sin(2π\widehat{x})}{2π}$.
